$comment: SUB-013 §4 — authoring tasks for the encoding evaluation.
Each task asks a model to write one node's `parameters` object given only that node's catalog
entry. The entry is served twice: once as the catalog was before this task (dynamicPorts prose,
no parameterEncoding) and once with the encodings. Nothing else differs.
Grading needs no expected answer. The model's own output is fed to the node's real dynamic-port
hook, and a key is correct when the hook generates a port with that name — the same test the
runtime applies, which is to say none at all: a wrong key generates nothing and is silently
ignored. `requires` names the ports the task cannot be considered done without, so a model
cannot score well by emitting only the seeds.
`States` is first because it is the hardest: four key formulas, one of them two-variable, and a
value name with a space in it.

tasks.instruction: A toggle with two states called `true` and `false`, animating one number called `pos` between 100 when true and 0 when false.
Two states `on` and `off`, animating a colour called `bg color` — Primary when on, Grey when off.
Three states `idle`, `hover` and `pressed`, animating one number called `scale`: 1, 1.1 and 0.95 respectively.
Format the string `Hello {firstName} {lastName}`, setting `firstName` to 'Ada' and `lastName` to 'Lovelace'.
A component state holding two properties: `isOpen`, starting true, and `selectedId`, starting 0. Set a starting value for each.
An Object node with the properties `title` and `price`, giving `title` the value 'Widget' and `price` the value 9.99.
Set two properties on an object: `title` to 'Widget' and `price` to 9.99.
Send an event on the channel `cart-updated` with a payload of `itemId` and `quantity`, setting `itemId` to 'abc' and `quantity` to 2.
An expression computing `width * scale`, with `width` set to 100 and `scale` set to 2.
An And node combining three boolean inputs, all set to true.
A Close Popup node with two close actions, `save` and `discard`. Wire nothing; just declare the actions and give each its signal input.
Call a cloud function with two parameters, `userId` set to 'u1' and `token` set to 't1'.
